faqQ2: Is the client allowed on all servers?
faqA2: Yes. Moonlight doesn't contain any feature that violates server rules. The client is focused on optimization and innovation, and has no cheats or unfair advantages.
faqA3: Yes. Moonlight supports Android through PojavLauncher, Mojo, MJ, Zalith, and others.
faqQ4: Which Minecraft versions does MoonLight Client support?
faqA4: We currently have 1.8.9, with plans for more versions in the future.
faqQ5: What sets MoonLight Client apart from other clients?
faqA5: We focus on optimization and innovation. Our client aims to break away from the standard, running well on any machine and with surprising features.
faqQ6: Does MoonLight work on cracked Minecraft?
faqA6: Yes, our client operates with extreme security on both original and cracked Minecraft.
tos1Body: MoonLight Client is free software focused on performance optimization, FPS improvement, and visual customization. The Client is compatible with PC and Mobile platforms (through PojavLauncher) and supports original account authentication and local (cracked) account management.
tos2Body: By downloading, installing, or using the Client on any device, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, uninstall the software immediately.
tos3Body: We grant you a personal, free, limited, revocable, and non-exclusive license to use the Client on your devices. Use is strictly recreational and non-commercial.

tos4Li1: The Company is not responsible for blocks, bans, or punishments applied by third-party servers where the user chooses to play.
tos4Li2: The user must respect the specific rules of each server when using the Client's features.
tos5Li1: Modify and redistribute the Client under another name for profit.

tos6Body: The Client may receive automatic or manual updates for bug fixes and improvements on PojavLauncher or PC. These terms may be changed at any time, and continued use of the software means you accept the new guidelines.
priv1Body: Moonlight Client is free software focused on user privacy. We do not collect, store, or transmit identifiable personal data to external servers.
priv1Li: Your game settings, visual preferences, textures, and login profiles (original account tokens or cracked account names) are processed and saved strictly locally on your device's storage (PC or Mobile).
priv2Body: Moonlight Client has no access to, does not store, and does not intercept your passwords. Original account authentication is done directly with Microsoft's servers, and cracked accounts work only as local identifiers within the game.
priv3Body: Since we don't collect information, there is no sharing, selling, or renting of data to third parties or advertising companies.
priv4Body: To ensure the integrity of your local data and your device, the user must download Moonlight Client only through our official distribution channels. We are not responsible for files altered by third parties on unauthorized sites.
priv5Body: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect new changes to the software. Significant changes will be announced through our official channels.
